bayts.text: And guard the Remembrance through me and multiply my reward, in the present and the future, by the right of (the sūra) al-Ḥijr.
And bless, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), and grant peace upon him who drove pain toward others than me,
through You, as a reward from You, O Generous, and from him; and gratitude through him I long for.
the firmest handhold (Qurʾān 2:256), the pure, the highest, O You Who guided him as a guide and raised him.
and the Family and the Companions, by the right of (the sūra) an-Naḥl, O You Who protect from what brings drought.
And grant, by this poem, O Lord of humankind, to the master of humankind the finest glad tidings.
And make it a key of good things and of the aim, and the best reward and good pleasure without break.
And bless, O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), and grant peace upon him through whom I lead the learned
to the Straight Path with a leading that drives away every averse one with a driving.
And he is the Beloved, the good, the nobly descended, our master the purest, he is the well-related.
and the Family and the Companions; and by the Night Journey (al-Isrāʾ) grant me to be the gladness of every beholder,
without roaming or tremor, or exile, and bestow hospitality.
Grant me that provision be a guide to the best of the Gardens, possessed of safety and favours.
And write for me the rewards and clarity in all things, and spare me harshness.
And bless, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), and grant peace upon him through whom You spared me whoever wronged
already before, by his standing; and You led safety to me, and toward others than me goes the straitness of time.
And he is the Penitent, the Near, the Watchful; and he is the Answering, the Answered, the Chief.
his Family and his Companions; and be for me, by the sūra al-Kahf, and illumine all of me.
And bless with peace, O Opener, him whose mark is the Key (al-Miftāḥ),
the responsive, the noble-minded, and he is the companion, and his radiant Family, like whoever keeps (him) company.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) Maryam, and make my outpourings put the steady rains to shame.
And bless, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), with peace, him who was sent with teaching,
and he is Abū ṭ-Ṭayyib and the physician, O Everlasting toward Whom the intelligent tends.
his Family and his Companions; and the Remembrance, by the right of (the sūra) Ṭā Hā, grant me, and gratitude.
And grant everyone who has attached himself to me a lasting happiness, O my Lord.
And grant me a forgiveness whose like has not been preceded, and be for me with a fragrance.
And forgive my two parents and forgive all who have attached themselves to me, by grace, O All-Hearing.
And be pleased with the noble Companions, then with the composer of this poem, Lord, wherever he has appeared.
And forgive every believing man and woman, and lead them to wishes, for an assiduous gratitude.
And forgive every Muslim man and woman, and grant them from You good pleasure and mercy.
And forgive every doer of good, man and woman, and convey to them an increase of good deeds.
And bless, O Withholder (Al-Qābiḍ), and grant peace upon the Prophet and Messenger, the ladder,
that is, the possessor of the staff, the rider of the noble (camel), O You Who through him lead to me the best marvel,
his Family and his Companions, O my Lord; and spread over me the blessings of the Prophets (sūra al-Anbiyāʾ).
And forever bless them with peace, in whoever conformed to them without blame.
And make, by his mighty standing, this poem dearer to You than mighty acts of worship.
And bless, O Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), and grant peace upon the Arab Prophet, the banner,
and he is the noble and the elect, he through whom the nobles have made for my gladness,
he is the refined, he is the selected, and the Family, the Companions and whoever is chosen.
And grant me, by the Pilgrimage (sūra al-Ḥajj), without tremor, from You, wishes through the best of the revealed verses.
And bless, O Withholder, and grant peace upon him through whom You dispelled the darknesses,
that is, the remover of distresses, the raiser of ranks, O you through whom He has written my being your servant,
his Family, his Companions and the believers; and spread over me the blessings of the Believers (sūra al-Muʾminūn).
And bless, O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), and grant peace upon him through whom You effaced my pain,
without its ever being confirmed again, as You effaced what draws misfortune.
that is, the glory of the Arabs, the foremost of the Arabs, the most eloquent of the Arabs, the most precious of the Arabs,
and the Family and the Companions, by the right of (the sūra) an-Nūr, O Effacer of denial and dishonour.
And bless, O Honourer (Al-Muʿizz), with peace, him through whom my teaching has become clear,
and he is Your shining, piercing star (Qurʾān 86:3), and he is the succeeded, the precious, the Last (al-ʿĀqib),
and the Family and the Companions possessed of certainty; and be for me by the sanctity of the Criterion (sūra al-Furqān).
And bless, O Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), and grant peace upon the Messenger of Allah, the light of the learned,
the victorious star, the revered pole (quṭb), the watchful, the inspirer of longing, the generous, the meteor.
And grant me, by the Poets (sūra ash-Shuʿarāʾ), what I want, O You Who spared me the rebel before his intent.
And make my letters above every deed that is righteous, O You Who lead my hope to me.
And bless, O All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), O All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), him to whom the victories came,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and remove my pain
without ever turning it toward me, and protect me from toil unto the Gardens.
